# Headroom is a RATIO, not log2 stops.

column7: Happy path: conforming HDR Profile, H1..H8 all OK; CRWL agrees with the HAGC reference white so H7 reaches its AGREE branch. PQ, so 8.10.4 does not resolve a content headroom

8.10.4 resolution: HAGC reference white 300 vs CRWL 203, so the two 8.10.4 carriers DISAGREE. Linear, so the division actually happens: HAGC-first gives 600/300=2, CRWL-first would give 600/203=2.9557. The only fixture in either corpus that distinguishes the two orders, and the only one reaching H7's DISAGREE branch

REGRESSION fixture for the cross-axis divisor fixed in iccDEV 88672a2e. HAGC reference white 300 vs CRWL 203; CLL and DCV both 600; no DERH and no DRWL so 8.10.5 falls through to c); Linear so the content axis resolves. Both axes must now divide by the same HAGC-first 300 (a ruling for the display axis, whose clause names the CRWL entry) and give 2. Before the fix, 8.10.5 c) used the CRWL entry and gave 600/203 = 2.9557, and PAWG contradicted itself: H7 said the content reference white was 300 while H8 divided by 203 and called it the same quantity

HAGC FAMILY: four alternates (the encoding maximum) across 0-6 stops on both sides of a 3-stop baseline (0, 1.5 compress; 4.5, 6 expand), one mixing type, PCHIP slopes. Pins headroom blending and drives the HAGC evaluated view's heatmap, curve family and preview strip. HAGC reference white 203 = CRWL; DERH 3.0 = baseline. PQ, so 8.10.4 does not resolve a content headroom

HAGC BAKED FALLBACK: ProfiletoolHagcFamily with its identity AToB0/BToA0 replaced by iccHdrFallback's White Paper #62 bake (iccDEV 649fc750, 33^3 CLUT, headroom 1.0); every other tag copied, so classification, headroom and the gain curve are the family's. The only corpus profile whose baked-LUT policy and pre-amendment path render a real SDR image rather than PQ code values; scripts/check-hagc-baked.mjs pins grey agreement with the gain curve at headroom 1.0 and the per-channel clip of saturated highlights. PQ, so 8.10.4 does not resolve a content headroom

HAGC CLAMP: Headroom Adaptive Tone Map flag SET with ZERO alternate images - proposal 1.2.2.6 no tone mapping, baseline clamped to the target colour volume (CIccHagcEvaluator ClampsToTargetVolume). The flag-set twin of HagcHexData, whose flag is clear so the evaluator declines before reading the count. HAGC reference white 203 = CRWL; DERH 2.0 = baseline. PQ, so 8.10.4 does not resolve a content headroom
